hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *dimensions.yaml) cd "$(dirname "$f")" && out=$(python3 verify.py --quiet 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then printf "verify.py FAILED after editing dimensions.yaml:\n%s\n" "$(echo "$out" | grep -E "FAIL|WARN")" >&2; exit 2; else echo "verify.py: $(echo "$out" | tail -1)"; fi ;; esac; }
